snippet.title: JunkTrashHop! Lastest Build Video
snippet.description:
This is a build of Junk Trash Hop! a simple 2D platformer wich I am developing, hopefully gets finished this year!

Check the build here:
https://klonoz.itch.io/junk-trash-hop !

_ __ ___________________________________________ __ _
Junk Trash Hop was initially called Tower of Horizont, a game created for a 2015 jam called Impulsa Games Jams Codename IG243, where the goal was to recreate a game with the aesthetics of Atari.
Now has become a brand new game!
_ __ ___________________________________________ __ _
